about: Files that research/costs/cost_ledger.py reads from four retrieved run trees under tmp/, kept here at the same path relative to tmp/ so the ledger rebuilds byte-identically after those trees are deleted (the full trees are in private backup releases). 'verbatim' files are exact copies. 'seconds-only' files (steps.jsonl) keep one line per step with only the 'seconds' field, the only field the ledger reads; source_sha256 is the original file. The ledger checks every file below against its sha256 before it reads this snapshot.
